OPERATIVE_BINDINGS.CONSUMPTION_RULE: Exactly one exclusive no-overwrite identity-bearing CONSUMED_BEFORE_WRITE record for this existing key. Use existing qualified complete-write/file-fsync/directory-fsync/reread publication. Independently verify the persisted record before first destination content write. Existing record or ambiguous publication denies any second consumption; outcomes never delete/reset/reopen this record.
OPERATIVE_BINDINGS.DISPOSITION_RULE: Custodian revocation/supersession remains explicit immutable identity-bearing owner records in the same designated domain, naming affected subject/grant/effectiveness/key. Scan and reconcile such records before consumption; conflicting/unknown disposition denies use. No silent latest-file resolution.
OPERATIVE_BINDINGS.DOMAIN_LIMIT: Only this recovery grant/attempt, not all KGE-Forge authority. This is an existing repository governance-publication directory; no external host claim store or new directory is established.
OPERATIVE_BINDINGS.INITIAL_STATE_RULE: Before exercising the grant, custodian reconciles all actual recovery activity since issuance with the authorized operator and publishes a current identity-bearing status/use receipt stating the record-domain coverage and known unused/unrevoked/unsuperseded state, or UNKNOWN/CONSUMED/REVOKED. Do not infer initial UNUSED from empty destination or missing repository files.
OPERATIVE_BINDINGS.OWNER_FACTUAL_KNOWLEDGE_BOUNDARY: Owner governance declaration can designate custody/domain and report actual known issuance/use/revocation history; it is not technical proof of OS permissions, inode stability or descriptor enforcement. Unknown past use must remain unknown and block reuse.
OPERATIVE_BINDINGS.PRESERVATION: Append prospective binding supplement referencing existing identities. No existing grant/subject/effectiveness byte change, new recovery grant, retroactive authorization, refund, attempt reset or additional retry. Original failed profile-installation history remains separate and UNKNOWN.
